title: On Washing the linen at the spring
subtitle: 循环利用 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 循环利用（人与自然·环境保护·循环利用与节约）
meta: 主题语境：循环利用（人与自然·环境保护·循环利用与节约）　|　核心词汇：wash　|　正文 352 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 wash 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1959 the farmer ① washed the linen at the spring on the same day, and every child in the field said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three autumns on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the farmer ② washes the linen at the spring before dawn without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ wash the linen at the spring at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ washed the linen at the spring before — a line in the almanac for September 1953 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Washing the linen at the spring on the same day, the farmer said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the basket at the far fence, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ wash the road clean in one night before dawn, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Wash the road clean in one night at once and never mention it again.

By 1966 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the almanac, and a new child from the next field ⑧ washes the road clean in one night on the same day every autumn without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the fence, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ washed the linen at the spring again when nobody else would.

⑩ To wash the linen at the spring, my mother said in 1971, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the field remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the field forgets, somebody washes the linen at the spring before dawn again and somebody must wash the linen at the spring on the same day all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 洗涤（一般过去式 washed the linen at the spring：1959 年农人头一回这样做，当天就）
B. v. 洗涤（一般现在 washes the linen at the spring：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 洗涤（不定式 to wash the linen at the spring：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 洗涤（过去完成时 had washed the linen at the spring：1953 年九月的农事历上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 洗涤（动名词 washing the linen at the spring 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 冲走（wash the road clean in one night：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去冲走一夜之间把路面冲净）
G. v. 冲走（wash the road clean in one night：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 洗涤（后段两处：新来的孩子照例 washes the road clean in one night，而母亲又一次 washed the linen at the spring）

wash 意为“洗涤”，自那以后农人天没亮就把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 washes。
wash 意为“洗涤”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯洗涤在那眼泉边洗那些亚麻布”，此处为不定式 to wash the linen at the spring。
wash 意为“洗涤”，农事历里 九月 那行字说明早在 1966 年之前就有人洗涤过，故用过去完成时 had washed。
wash 意为“洗涤”，农人说“洗涤在那眼泉边洗那些亚麻布这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 washing the linen at the spring 作主语。
wash 意为“冲走”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去冲走一夜之间把路面冲净”，should ever 之后用原形 wash the road clean in one night。
wash 意为“冲走”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻冲走一夜之间把路面冲净（wash the road clean in one night at once），以后再也不要提起。
wash 意为“洗涤”，新来的孩子每个秋天都照例冲走一夜之间把路面冲净，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 washes。
wash 意为“洗涤”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次当天就洗涤在那眼泉边洗那些亚麻布，用一般过去式 washed 叙述。
wash 意为“洗涤”，结尾那句是母亲 1971 年的话：要洗涤在那眼泉边洗那些亚麻布，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和田垄记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 wash 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1959 the farmer washed the linen at the spring on the same day, and nobody in the field forgot it.
Even now the farmer washes the linen at the spring before dawn whenever the field asks.
Washing the linen at the spring on the same day, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever wash the road clean in one night before dawn, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new child from the next field washes the road clean in one night on the same day every autumn, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother washed the linen at the spring again, and the field remembered that half.
